license.sourceStatement: Mendeley Data version-4 landing page labels the dataset CC BY 4.0.

acquisition.reason: Version-4 archive supplied by the user; extracted raw files are cache-only and locked by SHA-256.

channelPolicy.diagnosticReason: Higher states are EKF-derived using a manoeuvring-model predictor; they are not independent measurements.

propulsionModePolicy.classificationBasis: Dataset contains powered twin-propeller/rudder channels and no sail or wind-force channels; reference-speed runs are non-maneuver calibration runs.

scientificScope.sourceArchitecture: twin-screw, twin-rudder wind-powered car carrier in motoring mode
scientificScope.claimLimit: Raw free-running trajectory evidence for propeller/rudder maneuvering-model structure in a twin-screw architecture variant; does not validate Vehicle B's single-screw configuration or USV-scale coefficients.
